title: Act: Add applyFocusedObject to BootScene to focus the matching object
summary: Add private applyFocusedObject(id) that focuses the matching SceneObject
description: Add a private method to BootScene that focuses the SceneObject whose spec.id equals the given id, reusing SceneObject.focus().
acceptance_criteria: applyFocusedObject('bookshelf') calls focus() on the object with spec.id 'bookshelf'
Objects with other ids are not focused by it

steps.action: Add a private method applyFocusedObject(id: string | null): void that loops over this.sceneObjects and, for the object whose spec.id === id and that is not already isFocused, calls o.focus().
steps.expected: BootScene compiles and the method focuses only the object with the given id
